events.title: Summer Regional Championships
events.description: Annual regional swimming competition featuring all four strokes and IM events. Open to all age groups. Medals awarded for top 3 finishers in each category.

events.title: Junior Swim Meet
events.description: A competitive meet for junior swimmers (ages 8-14). Focus on technique and personal best times. All participants receive a certificate of participation.

events.title: State Level Competition
events.description: State-level championship qualifier. Top performers advance to the national round. Strict adherence to FINA rules. Electronic timing used for all events.

events.title: Open Water Challenge
events.description: Open water swimming event at the lake. 1km, 2km, and 5km categories available. Wetsuits allowed for water temperatures below 20°C. Safety kayaks and medical staff on site.

events.title: Winter Invitational
events.description: End-of-year invitational meet. A great opportunity to finish the season with strong personal bests. Heats and finals format for all age groups.
